errors.evidence: The description claims the two line plots have circle markers, but the lines in the plot are continuous and do not have any markers.

errors.text_span: Der Abfluss beginnt 2005 bei etwa 70.000 Mrd. Euro, steigt bis 2006 auf rund 120.000, fällt 2008 auf etwa 60.000, erreicht 2010 einen weiteren Höhepunkt bei ca. 110.000, ... steigt 2018 auf ein Maximum von ca. 170.000, fällt 2019 auf ca. 130.000, steigt 2020 auf ca. 160.000, fällt 2022 auf ca. 100.000 und endet 2024 bei ca. 100.000. Der Zufluss beginnt 2005 bei ca. 50.000, steigt 2006 auf ca. 70.000, fällt 2008 auf ca. 20.000, ... steigt 2018 auf ein Maximum von ca. 140.000, fällt 2019 auf ca. 60.000, steigt 2020 auf ca. 150.000, fällt 2022 auf ca. 50.000 und endet 2024 bei ca. 40.000.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly interprets the y-axis values. For example, it states the outflow in 2005 is '70.000 Mrd. Euro', which would be 70 trillion Euro. The actual value is approximately 75,000 million Euro, or 75 billion Euro. This error of reporting values as 'X Mrd. Euro' instead of just 'X' (where the unit is already established as billions) is repeated for every numerical value described for the line plots.

The description claims the outflow (Abfluss) remains 'relatively stable' from 2010 to 2013. However, the plot shows a notable fluctuation in this period, dropping from approx. 110,000 to approx. 75,000 and then rising again.
The description states that the outflow (Abfluss) rises to 160,000 in 2020. The plot shows the outflow is around 120,000 in 2020. The value rises to approx. 165,000 in 2021, not 2020.
The description states that the outflow (Abfluss) falls to 100,000 in 2022. The plot shows the value in 2022 is approximately 160,000. It is the value in 2023 that is closer to 100,000.
The description states that the inflow (Zufluss) rises to 150,000 in 2020. The plot shows the value is actually around 150,000 in 2021, while in 2020 it is much lower, at approximately 90,000.

The description states the inflow (Zufluss) falls to 50,000 in 2022. The value in 2022 is approximately 45,000, so 50,000 is a reasonable approximation, but the description previously misidentified the peak year, making the sequence of events incorrect. The peak was in 2021, not 2020, and the fall happens after 2021.

errors.text_span: wo ein positiver Wert von +27.499 Mrd. Euro auftritt
errors.evidence: The description reports the positive difference value as '+27.499 Mrd. Euro'. The y-axis unit is already in Mrd. Euro, and the values are in millions. The value is 27,499 million Euro, which is 27.499 billion Euro. The description adds 'Mrd. Euro' to the number, which would mean 27.499 trillion Euro, a factual error of a factor of one billion.
